analysis: The two units supplied (CHANGELOG.md base_text, start lines 392 and 617) are documentation only: release-note prose with no executable code, config, or permission changes. The entries describe security-relevant behavior in other files (App Attest serving authorization, build qualification and revocation, SSD prefix cache disk budget and TTL, MDM-optional enrollment and unenroll flow, first-content SLA, promotion settlement), mapped to T-041, T-052..T-058, TB-011 and A-015..A-017. Changelog text cannot itself regress those controls. The corresponding source code was not supplied, so claims in these notes are unverified and a later source pass should check the code actually matches them, particularly the App Attest per-dispatch authorization fences and the SSD cache policy files.
